_source: The Flight design document pp. 35-36 (the long match: the seasons, what they change and reward, their events) and p. 49 (pacing). Days are game days (2 real minutes each, the user's call), so a four-season match is 16 days.

seasons.name: Spring
seasons.sea: Fish rise to the shallows; lagoons are full; mates are plentiful
seasons.rewards: Growth: nests, clutches, the first fishers
seasons.event_what: Every ground doubles for a day; the sharks sleep

seasons.name: Summer
seasons.sea: Grounds thin near islands; the blue is rich; thermals all day
seasons.rewards: Expansion, trade, the first wars; Bombers fly cheap on thermals
seasons.event_what: A school of big fish crosses the map in a day: whoever follows it eats for a week

seasons.name: Autumn
seasons.sea: Storms; grounds shift; the kraken wakes more
seasons.wind: Gales from one quarter for a day at a time
seasons.rewards: Caches (the smokehouse matters), sieges, raids under fog
seasons.event_what: Every wild bird on the map flies through: mates are free for a day, and so is conversion

seasons.name: Winter
seasons.sea: Fish go deep (Deep Dive pays); the lagoons freeze on northern maps
seasons.rewards: Holding what you have; the deciding war; the score (Winter's holdings count double)
seasons.event_what: One game day of darkness: Watchers and Shadow colonies own it
